name: page_replace
description: Replace the content of pages with pages of another PDF (same count). Links, comments, form fields and bookmarks on the original pages stay, as in Acrobat. Undoable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

from_pages.description: 1-based page numbers of the other file, in order (default: its first pages).

path.description: A file path (relative to --root when set).
